scope: EU-wide published procurement notices, filtered to German buyers/place of performance in the target states and districts

licence: Verified legal distinctions: procurement notices freely reusable commercially/non-commercially unless otherwise noted under Commission Decision 2011/833/EU; SIMAP system metadata CC0 1.0; editorial website content CC BY 4.0. update_frequency: Published daily and monthly XML packages; actual publication days follow the release calendar rather than a seven-days-per-week assumption.
